title: Theory to what Mall World is...
content: I've been having these dreams about Mall World for quite sometime, and I often wondered about what this place is. After my most recent dream about it, my girlfriend noticed something about me while I napped leading me to the following theory. During my latest dream, my girlfriend noticed I stopped breathing in my sleep for a nearly a minute. She told me she was scared and almost waked me but I soon started taking small breaths before I resumed breathing normally. What if it's connected? What if when our bodies start doing something that puts us in danger of dying, that's what triggers Mall World? For example: whether it's sleep apnea, not being able to breathe, something with our heart or other major organs malfunctioning, that when our minds recognize we're in certain peril and close to shuffling off this mortal plain... it opens the portal to Mall World, which acts as a loading zone for the dead? Thoughts?
